sources.title: 201 E Washington Street Phoenix Coworking Office Space | Industrious
sources.notes: Official Industrious page confirms Indy by Industrious Downtown Phoenix at 201 E Washington Street, Suite 500, Phoenix, AZ 85004. It describes coworking, private offices, meeting rooms, fast secure Wi-Fi, craft coffee/tea, printing, snacks, 24/7 member access, transit access, and starting prices for offices, day passes/coworking, and meeting rooms.
